title: Genesis 1 — In the beginning
description: A draft Back to the Bible study on creation, order, and God's good design.
author: ROLCC Fellowship Team

sections.heading: Observe
sections.body: Read Genesis 1:1-5. What repeated words or patterns do you notice?

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: Where do you need to trust that God brings light into disorder this week?

discussionQuestions: What does it mean that God creates by speaking?
How does creation shape the way we see our work and rest?
